CustomField.label: Advanced: Found Display Value
CustomField.description: Optional. Used only when Check Type is Check fields on this record. A formula whose result is shown as the "Found" value on the result row (the left side of a comparison — what the record has). Leave blank to keep the default behavior (no Found value). The Pass Condition (Formula) still decides pass/fail. Example: BLANKVALUE(Debit_Total__c, 0).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. Formula shown as "Found" on the row (e.g. BLANKVALUE(Debit_Total__c, 0)). Pass/fail is still decided by Pass Condition (Formula). Blank = no Found value.
